summary: Synth brass (openDAW's Neon preset, CZ-style): 80s brass stabs for synth-pop, funk and synthwave
label: Synth Brass
body: Short chord stabs in MIDI 52-79 on the offbeats.

Register: MIDI 48-84 (openDAW names C3 = 60); outside it, it sounds wrong. Sound: openDAW/Brass, openDAW's factory preset for Neon: make_instrument (sound "openDAW/Brass") makes the track with its notes in one edit; apply makes it empty.
